gloss: Arima Onsen (ancient hot spring near Kobe)

definitions.explanation: A hot-spring resort in the hills behind Kobe, in Hyogo Prefecture, and one of the oldest in Japan, mentioned in records from the eighth century. Famous for its reddish-brown, iron-rich water called {金泉|きんせん}.
